{{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=water| nickname=Wani-Wani | jnickname=ワニワニ| tmnickname=Wani-Wani| pokemonname=Feraligatr| image=[[File:Marina Feraligatr.png|240px]] | caption=Wani-Wani | location=[[New Bark Town]] | evolution=2| epnum=The Legend of Thunder!| epname=The Legend of Thunder!| firstevoep=The Legend of Thunder!| firstevonametiming=Prior to| firstevoname=The Legend of Thunder!| prevonum=158| numeps1=an unknown number of | firststagename=Totodile| numeps2=an unknown number of| secondstagename=Croconaw| evo1num=159| evo2num=160| secondevoep=DP041| secondevonametiming=Prior to| secondevoname=A Stand-Up Sit-Down! | current=[[Party|With Marina]] | java1=N/A | java2=Unknown| java3=Unknown| enva2=[[Carter Cathcart|Jimmy Zoppi]]| enva3=Unknown| }} '''Wani-Wani''' (Japanese: '''ワニワニ''' ''Wani-Wani'') is a {{p|Feraligatr}} that {{jo|Marina}} owns and her [[first partner Pokémon]]. ==History== [[File:LoT first partners.png|thumb|250px|left|Marina picking Totodile to be her [[first partner Pokémon]]]] ===Pre-series=== Wani-Wani was obtained as a Totodile from [[Professor Elm]] on the same day that [[Vincent]] received his {{TP|Vincent|Chikorita}} and {{jo|Jimmy}} received his {{TP|Jimmy|Cyndaquil}}, as seen in the Japanese opening and ending theme "[[A New Oath]]". ===''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]''=== Marina used Wani-Wani to battle Jimmy's {{p|Beedrill}} after {{DL|Marina (Johto)|Pink}} was defeated. Jimmy then called Beedrill back and used his Typhlosion to battle the {{type|Water}} Pokémon. During the battle, Marina was revealed to be in sync with Wani-Wani's actions. Despite the type disadvantage, Typhlosion managed to stand up to Wani-Wani's attacks. However, the battle ended without a winner being declared because Marina and Jimmy ended up seeing from a distance the change in climate caused by [[Team Rocket]]'s attack on {{OBP|Raikou|The Legend of Thunder!}}. Shortly afterwards, Wani-Wani was returned to its {{i|Poké Ball}}. ==={{aniseries|RS}}=== Wani-Wani made a cameo appearance along with its Trainer in the beginning of ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]'', where Marina and her Pokémon were seen running in a plain as a {{p|Lugia}} appeared next to them. ==={{aniseries|DP}}=== Wani-Wani was revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Feraligatr during an Internet broadcast of a [[Pokémon Contest]] in ''[[DP041|A Stand-Up Sit-Down!]]''. It was used alongside Pink in a [[Double Performance]], during which it used {{m|Aqua Tail}} to lift Pink in the air so the Balloon Pokémon could use its {{m|Psychic}} attack to splash the water. {{-}} ==Personality and characteristics== Despite Wani-Wani's brief appearance in ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'', it was shown to be in sync with its Trainer and was able to hold its own during battle. After it evolved sometime before ''[[DP041|A Stand-Up Sit-Down!]]'', Wani-Wani was also shown to have good performing skills as Marina was able to earn the title of [[Top Coordinator]]. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{water color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{water color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a Totodile ! style="background:#{{water color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a Croconaw |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Marina Totodile.png|180px]] | [[File:Marina Croconaw.png|180px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|water||Wani-Wani {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Croconaw Water Gun|1=Aqua Tail}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Water Gun
as a Croconaw|1=Aqua Tail}}}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|The Legend of Thunder!|The Legend of Thunder!}} {{anmov|water|Aqua Tail|DP041|A Stand-Up Sit-Down!}} {{anmov/f|water}} ==Trivia== * The nickname Wani-Wani either comes from ワニノコ ''Waninoko'', {{p|Totodile}}'s Japanese name, or just from the Japanese word for {{wp|crocodile}}, 鰐 ''wani''. * It is the only first partner Pokémon from ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'' that wasn't in its final form in its introduction, as [[Jimmy's Typhlosion]] and [[Vincent's Meganium]] are. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo2|Totodile|Croconaw|Feraligatr}} {{Marina's Pokémon|water}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Marina's Pokémon]] [[Category:Animation characters' first Pokémon]] [[Category:Nicknamed Pokémon]] [[es:Wani Wani]] [[fr:Aligatueur de Marina]] [[it:Wani-Wani]]
